feeds.title: HiP Paris
feeds.description: Visiting Paris for the first time? Been here before and want to explore a new part of town? HiP Paris Blog will point you in the right direction and introduce you to off-the-beaten-path places, hip and happening people and events, and experiences you might otherwise overlook.

feeds.title: Bonjour Paris
feeds.description: BonjourParis.com publishes the most complete and original content about Paris activities and France travel. Online since 1995, Bonjour Paris was one of the first websites dedicated to publishing France-related travel content. We can help plan your trip to Paris.

feeds.title: Paris Perfect Blog
feeds.description: Discover the inside scoop on the latest events in Paris, hottest shopping and dining spots, travel tips, best Paris tour experiences, exclusive offers and latest Paris news from the Paris Perfect team. Our goal is to offer you an extraordinary experience in the most beautiful city in the world by enhancing your vacation and helping you to explore and experience the delights of living in Paris.

feeds.title: Secrets of Paris
feeds.description: Secrets of Paris is the insider's guide to Paris news, events, sightseeing and living in the City of Light. Established in 1999, the Secrets of Paris is one of the oldest independent and locally-owned websites about Paris in English. The Secrets of Paris website and newsletter were created by Heather Stimmler, an American-born journalist living in France since 1995.

feeds.title: My Parisian Life
feeds.description: I'm Yanique Francis. I've been living in Paris for 15 years . You will discover fun, local, and authentic Paris with me. No tourists traps!

feeds.title: The Paris Review
feeds.description: The Paris Review is a literary magazine featuring original writing, art, and in-depth interviews with famous writers. The Paris Review Daily blog is a cultural gazette featuring new writing, artwork, and thoughtful commentary.

feeds.title: David Lebovitz Blog
feeds.description: Professional chef and author, David Lebovitz, is a household name in the culinary world. He now lives in Paris, and takes every photo, tests every recipe, and writes every blog post himself!

feeds.title: About Paris
feeds.description: Let us help you make the most of your visit to this beautiful city that is Paris by providing practical information about getting to and around the city.

feeds.title: Victorian Paris
feeds.description: This site is the repository of research material for my first novel Fame and Infamy set in 1870s Paris. Many of the articles are excerpts from texts written in the 19th century. Wherever I can, I will include my sources and recommend reading material.

feeds.title: Petite in Paris
feeds.description: Documenting my experience while living abroad in Paris was my 'aha moment'. With a little encouragement from my family and friends, Petite in Paris was born. My goal is to provide fashion insights not only for other petite women but everyone, while showcasing my style around the city.

feeds.title: Crash Magazine
feeds.description: FASHION | ART | MUSIC | TRENDS | BEAUTY | MOVIE | DIARY | NIGHT. Pioneering trendy French magazine, CRASH has become in fifteen years a reference. A high-end, independent French magazine published each trimester and sold in all major press stores, CRASH is dedicated to fashion, art, cinema and celebrities.

feeds.title: paris breakfasts
feeds.description: Hi I'm Carol Gillott, My Mom taught me watercolors at 5 and I'm still at it. Now I live on l'Ile Saint-Louis by the Seine. Do consider subscribing to my Paris letters and maps on Etsy. Enjoy a taste of Paris in your mailbox every month. Savor with hot chocolate and a croissant. I paint Paris dreams.

feeds.title: I Prefer Paris
feeds.description: Eye Prefer Paris is an ex-New Yorker's insider's guide to Paris. Richard Nahem writes his blog from his fabulous 18th century apartment in the fashionable Marais district of Paris. Eye Prefer Paris....but then, doesn't everyone? This is a weblog about the wonderful nook and crannies one can find in this amazing city.

feeds.title: Postcards from Paris & elsewhere
feeds.description: Postcards from Paris & elsewhere .....I am, like you, a work sometimes in progress and sometimes in regress

feeds.title: The American in Paris
feeds.description: The American in Paris is a collaborative, reader-supported platform (begun as one man's immigration chronicle) offering practical guidance, cultural insights, and support for Americans navigating the legal, bureaucratic, and lifestyle challenges of settling in France

feeds.title: YOGA VILLAGE PARIS Blog
feeds.description: Building community with each breath, Yoga Village cultivates community partnerships to share yoga with everyone in our village.

feeds.title: Blog About Paris , Fashion, Food & Travel
feeds.description: This Paris blog is created and maintained by me, Solli, a Swedish Expat living in Paris working with Online Marketing on a Shipping & Logistic company. I'm also a Photographer but when I'm not behind the lens, on a fashion show or setting off to a new destination I love to be in the kitchen and play around with whole, organic and seasonal food. In this blog I share some glimpses of my everyday lif

feeds.title: Paris Insights
feeds.description: Paris Insights...an insider's guide to the history, culture, and contemporary life of Paris. Paris Insights looks beyond the stereotypes that many travelers hold about the City of Light. Our mission is to share our intimate knowledge of Paris with a larger public.

feeds.title: Toffee Bits and Chocolate Chips
feeds.description: An American Expat in Paris attending the Cordon Bleu. Follow Molly on her baking adventures. She shares wonderful healthy as well as indulgent recipes for cookies, brownies, cakes and more!

feeds.title: Paris Missives... - 'The reluctant Francophile...'
feeds.description: A blog by Randy on all about food in Paris, where to eat, restaurants and its reviews. This is my story. A little different take from other blogs about Paris, since all I've ever seen are love stories about Paris from Francophiles who are like in a dream state and enamored with anything French.

feeds.title: paris breakfasts
feeds.description: The blog Paris Breakfasts is a beautifully illustrated, heartfelt travel journal by Carol Gillott—an artist and writer based in Paris—sharing watercolor paintings, photographs, and personal stories from her daily Parisian adventures and regional escapades

feeds.title: Everyday Parisian
feeds.description: Everyday Parisian was founded in 2016 as a result of this desire to meld the French lifestyle with American surroundings and to create a community with a shared love for Paris. It aims to highlight the fun and new ways to 'Frenchify' daily life, offers travel recommendations, shares fashion inspiration, and much more.

feeds.title: Paris Select Book
feeds.description: Discover the best selections for an exceptional Parisian experience with Paris Select book, the guide to Parisian trends!

feeds.title: Parisian Niche
feeds.description: Parisian Niche: a personal lens on all things Parisian—from French travel and lifestyle to recommended reads—delivered with charm, insight, and a touch of panache.

feeds.title: ELLE Magazine
feeds.description: Fashion magazine created by women for women: beauty advice, women's fashion, cooking recipes

feeds.title: Paris Unlocked
feeds.description: Paris Unlocked is the ultimate travel guide to Paris & France for culturally curious readers. In-depth features, travel tips, history & news.

feeds.title: Vivre Paris
feeds.description: Vivre Paris Magazine portrays Paris like you've never seen before. Read about culture, restaurants, exclusive, sport, healthy, beauty, well-being, concept-store and more. Vivre Paris makes you discover all the Parisian news!

feeds.title: Carin Olsson
feeds.description: 'Paris in Four Months' (the previous name of this website) started out as a place where I was able to share my experiences on this new adventure but has now turned into so much more. This website is my baby, a creative outlet and a place where I'm happy to share my passion for photography and all the beautiful things and places I come across along my way. I hope you'll enjoy it as much as I enjoy sharing these moments with you.

feeds.title: Paris by Mouth
feeds.description: A guide to food & wine in Paris, France including reviews of restaurants, bistros, wine bars, bakeries & shops selling cheese, wine, pastry, chocolate and more.

feeds.title: Lost In Cheeseland
feeds.description: Lindsey is a food & travel writer based in Paris. Musings on food, love, life and struggles in Paris from a Philadelphia native. She is a Philadelphian expat who fell in love with a Frenchman and moved to Paris.

feeds.title: bolaoged.com
feeds.description: Hello, I am Bola Olivia Ogedengbe, lover of God and lover of life, in that order. After working for many years as a conference interpreter I now write, pastor, preach full time. I help people connect to God and experience His fullness in their lives. As you read these articles and books, you will be drawn into a deeper life in God, a life more fruitful, joyful, meaningful than many imagine possible.

feeds.title: Paris Through My Lens
feeds.description: I am a former elementary school teacher, a full-time photographer, lover of all things French, obsessive Paris traveler, enthusiastic church and community volunteer, and grandmother to 5 delightful grandchildren. Blog by Virginia.

feeds.title: Alexander Lobrano
feeds.description: A Paris dining diary memories cum guidebook to the best restaurants in Paris, and a gastronomic tour to France with gorgeous photographs and terrific recipes.

feeds.title: Paris Adèle Blog
feeds.description: You can take a girl out of Paris, but you can't take Paris out of the girl! francophile, loves Paris in the winter & believes in Point Zero.

feeds.title: A Yankee in Paris
feeds.description: No animals were harmed in the making of this blog... A personal blog based on stories of my life as I meander through the horse world. From Thoroughbred farms to a doctorate, and everything in between.

feeds.title: Paris Weekender Blog
feeds.description: A collection of ideas for Paris weekends: staying put and getting out of town.

feeds.title: Meet Me In Paree
feeds.description: Nikita is a British/Chinese blogger living in Paris. She likes taking pretty pictures and eating cakes. Meet Me In Paree is a photo diary blog of outfits and outfit inspiration written by Nikita.

feeds.title: Expat with Kids in Paris
feeds.description: A transitionary home for my soul stuck somewhere between the Swiss Alps and Parisian chic.

feeds.title: Paris and Beyond
feeds.description: Paris reached out and grabbed me when I was 8 years old and it only took me 40 years to actually get there! I love Paris, its people, its architecture and all of France. This is a photo blog about Paris and occasionally other places in the world.

feeds.title: Paris: People, Places and Bling
feeds.description: Theadora's Field Guide to Shopping in Paris. Theadora Brack, Editorial Director Theadoraâs weekly column on Paris covers art, architecture, fashion, cuisine and shopping, always gussied up with some gossip and historical tidbits.

feeds.title: My Beautiful Paris - Norma's Blog
feeds.description: A personal guide for your fun and stylish Parisian adventure by Norma Thiessen.

feeds.title: Prête-Moi Paris
feeds.description: I am an American in Paris…I came to Paris one year as a study abroad student, yes…I know, SO typical!, and I decided to make it my home. Author of this blog, here you will find my musings, my ideas, Paris fashion, places I love, things I test, things I taste, travel tips, inspirations and more… all surrounding the obvious theme and my muse : Paris, France.

feeds.title: Woman of a Certain Age in Paris
feeds.description: Diana Bishops' weekly blog about traveling for women over 50. Travel tips, bargains, insider tips & deals all by veteran journalist, Diana Bishop.

feeds.title: paris (im)perfect
feeds.description: Sion Dayson is paris (im)perfect. Writer, dreamer, she moved to France on - no exaggerating - a romantic whim. As you can imagine, a lot can go wrong (and very right!) with such a (non)plan.

feeds.title: Roisin Grace Blog
feeds.description: A blog documenting the life of an English girl currently living in the beautiful city of Paris - all things travel, culture and life related! Blog by Róisín Astell.

feeds.title: Another Américaine in Paris
feeds.description: The adventures (and mishaps) of a new expat living la vie en rose in Paris, maybe.

feeds.title: Invisible Paris
feeds.description: A celebration of the parts of Paris that would be refused entry to the ville musee today. The force of nature behind this force of knowledge is a blogger by the name of Adam. Adam shares everything from the city's first forest - destined to open in 2014 - to architect artists, sketching the city from a pigeon's point of view.

feeds.title: Planning for Paris
feeds.description: This blog was inspired by two sisters who dream of Paris rainstorms in our Wellies, colorful macarons for breakfast, French baguettes with soft brie daily visits to the Louvre and Lauderée, tours of the Eiffel tower in our cardigans and ballet flats, endless smiles and laughs in the City of Love. Won't you join us as we plan for Paris?

feeds.title: Peter's Paris
feeds.description: Peter Olson is a retired Swede, living in Paris since 1974.

feeds.title: Music & Wanderlust
feeds.description: Music & Wanderlust is a blog that weaves together 'festival music, travel culture, and destination-based music experiences,' offering inspiring stories, tips, and cultural insights for adventurous music lovers

feeds.title: Sneak-art
feeds.description: Check out the latest Sneakers, Air Jordan sneakers, and the latest Street Culture trends: Street Art, Street Art, Graffiti, Art Toy, Fashion & Lifestyle.

feeds.title: PARIS DEFINED M A G A Z I N E
feeds.description: Covers articles about what to do, eat, visit, and sleep with by wily local raconteurs.

feeds.title: Colleen's Paris
feeds.description: Paris information, helpful tips, advice for travelers alone, with children, the handicapped, first time or return travelers.

feeds.title: Janice MacLeod
feeds.description: Author of PARIS LETTERS, a New York Times best selling travel memoir about leaving the fast lane to become an artist in Paris. Blog by Janice MacLeod.

feeds.title: The Paris Blog
feeds.description: A guide to Paris France by insider expatriates who live in Paris, France. Save money, find top restaurants and shops.
